effects.l1: Throw: throw any held object up to Metal pounds, 1 damage.
effects.l2: Propel: launch an object within reach up to Metal ×3 pounds, 2 damage; catch thrown everyday objects (Water + Dodging).
effects.l3: Wall of missiles: throw Water small objects at one target in one Attack Test, damage = objects; catch thrown weapons.
effects.l4: Whirlwind of missiles: Water ×2 objects split among several targets; catch Water objects.

system.description: Turn everyday objects into missiles (Metal + Throwing vs Passive Defense, range Metal ×3 yards).
